claims: Small synthetic set: results describe THIS set only and are not a statistical estimate of production accuracy.
limitations: Small synthetic set, hand-authored by the same team that wrote the config; no statistical generalization.
"intent" labels encode documented roles, which are routing hints, not measured quality differences.

Capability-difference cases are defense-in-depth probes: in production the capability plane removes a worker that lacks a capability BEFORE SystemOne runs, so such an option normally never reaches a backend.
Only workers that exist in config/workers.yaml appear as options; no capability difference is invented.

description_swap.note: claude_code/codex descriptions swapped, labels kept; follows_label = choice unchanged

description_swap_all.note: all two-option answerable semantic cases; metadata of the two options swapped, labels kept

abstention.note: informative abstention would fire mostly on escalate-gold decisions and on cases the plain variant gets wrong

layer3_end_to_end_routing.note: policy validity of the final route, not decision optimality
